admin-role-id.description: An administrator role ID reported in an admin event.

admin-role-name.description: An administrator role name reported in an admin event.

affected-group.description: The group email reported as the subject of the admin event.

affected-user.description: The user email reported as the subject of the admin event.

document-id.description: The Google Drive document ID reported with the event.

document-owner.description: The reported document owner, which can be an email address or a shared drive name.

document-title.description: The document title reported by Google Drive.

document-type.description: The document type reported by Google Drive.

error-code.description: The error code in the reported event status.

error-message.description: The error message in the reported event status.

event-index.description: One-based ordinal of the event in the parent activity events array.

event-name.description: The native event name reported in the activity.

event-status.description: The reported event outcome, when supplied.

event-type.description: The native event type reported in the activity.

http-status-code.description: The HTTP status code in the reported event status.

login-challenge-method.description: The challenge method reported for the sign-in.

login-challenge-status.description: The challenge outcome reported for the sign-in.

login-failure-type.description: The sign-in failure reason reported by the provider.

login-type.description: The sign-in credential type as reported by the provider.

new-visibility.description: The reported visibility of the Drive file after the event, when present.

oauth-application-name.description: The application name reported in an OAuth token event.

oauth-client-id.description: An OAuth client ID reported in a token event.

oauth-scope.description: The scope value reported in the token event, preserving the original representation.

old-visibility.description: The prior visibility of the Drive file as reported by Google.

organizational-unit.description: The organizational unit named by the admin event.

parameter.description: One native event parameters entry, serialized as JSON and indexed by its source position.

resource-id.description: An identifier in the native event resourceIds array.

sensitive-parameter.description: One native event sensitiveParameters entry, serialized as JSON and indexed by its source position.

setting-name.description: The name of the setting reported in the admin event.

shared-drive-id.description: A Google shared drive ID reported with the event.

sharing-target.description: The user, group or domain reported as the target of a sharing change.

suspicious-login.description: Whether Google flagged the sign-in as unusual.

description: One event in a Google Workspace Reports API activity with its source ordinal, parameters and investigation fields.
name: google-workspace-audit-event
